description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Targets 2 Afflicted you control

Command two Afflicted with a single action instead of one. Both receive the same command and act on it in the order you choose. If a Verse of the Multitude practitioner takes this feat, it instead lets them command one additional Afflicted beyond their group action once per encounter.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Command all/multiple Afflicted with one action" has no rule-element automation anywhere in pf2e-source: grep -rli "command" pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/ and find pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element -iname "*command*" both return zero hits. Minion "Command" in real pf2e is a manually GM-tracked action with no rule-element automation of any kind.
